headline: GIFT Nifty signals rebound as markets reopen; US tariff reports and SpiceJet fleet crisis in focus

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: GIFT Nifty indicates a strong rebound for the Indian market with 26,000 seen as a key resistance level
Indian markets are reopening today after being closed for the Guru Nanak Jayanti holiday on November 24
Reports suggest the US is planning to hike tariffs on India and 15 other countries, weighing on sentiment
Global cues are mixed as the Nasdaq and S&P 500 ended lower while investors assess US market leadership changes
whatHappening: SpiceJet faces a severe operational crisis as its fleet has shrunk to six aircraft, reducing daily flights to twenty
Investors are recovering from a massive sell-off on November 23 where the Sensex plunged over 1,400 points
Viral reports of potential fresh tech layoffs at Google and Microsoft in India are causing caution in the IT sector
Several major stocks including Tata Steel, NALCO, and Indian Bank are in focus for today's trading session
summary: Indian markets are expected to open higher today following a holiday, supported by positive GIFT Nifty signals. Investors remain cautious due to reports of potential US tariff hikes and recent volatility that saw major indices plunge. SpiceJet is under significant pressure as its operational fleet has dwindled to just six aircraft.
